title: On an Instance of the Small Cohen-Macaulay Conjecture II
summary: We show that any $d$-dimensional local ring $A$ with a dualizing complex, $\mathrm{depth} A=d-1$, and cyclic deficiency module $K^{d-1}(A)$ admits a maximal Cohen--Macaulay module. It is constructed as the unique nonzero cohomology module of the cone of the derived morphism induced by a surjection $A\to K^{d-1}(A)$. This gives new cases of the small Cohen--Macaulay conjecture. When $A$ is quasi-Gorenstein, this module is identified with the first syzygy of the canonical module $ω_{A/xA}$, for any $x\in\operatorname{ann}_A K^{d-1}(A)$ that is regular on $A$.
